name: Quality loop (critic routes back)
description: Fixture for patterns.md section 8: Quality loop (critic routes back).

steps.name: Requirements
steps.prompt: Write requirements.md: the numbered requirements the brief implies.

steps.name: Drafter
steps.prompt: Write the draft to draft.md. If review-notes.md exists, revise draft.md to address every point in it.

steps.name: Reviewer
steps.prompt: Read draft.md and requirements.md. Write review-notes.md. Then reply with exactly one line: {"decision": "pass"} if every requirement is met, otherwise {"decision": "revise"}.

revise.feedback: Revise draft.md to address every point in review-notes.md.

steps.name: Finalizer
steps.prompt: Read draft.md and reply with the final document only.
